verdict.rationale: Munito AI documents OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs for Chat Completions, Responses, speech to text and Messages, but nothing in the evidence names a GET /v1/models-style endpoint for listing the live catalog programmatically. The 'Choose a model' docs page is human-readable documentation, not an API, and the OpenAPI spec probe confirms only that a spec file exists, not what endpoints it contains. OpenAI compatibility alone does not show that a models-listing endpoint is implemented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented GET /v1/models-style endpoint
